preconditions.description: Input n is a multiple of 4 and within the range [4, 1000].

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= n**2 - 1 for row in stdout.splitlines() for x in row.split())
postconditions.description: Every integer in the output grid is between 0 and n²-1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == n and all(len(row.split()) == n for row in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output is an n × n grid (n rows, each with n space-separated integers).

postconditions.expression: len({int(x) for row in stdout.splitlines() for x in row.split()}) == n**2
postconditions.description: All integers from 0 to n²-1 appear exactly once in the grid.

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(x) == int(y) for x in row.split()) for row in stdout.splitlines()) == False and all(any(int(x) == int(y) for x in [row.split()[i] for row in stdout.splitlines()]) for i in range(n)) == False
postconditions.description: No duplicate values exist in any row or column (implicitly guaranteed by Q3).

postconditions.expression: (lambda grid: all(any(int(x) == int(y) for x in row.split()) for row in grid) == False and all(any(int(x) == int(y) for x in [row.split()[i] for row in grid]) for i in range(n)) == False) and (lambda grid: (lambda rows: all(rows[0] == rows[i] for i in range(1, len(rows))))([int(' '.join(row.split()), 2) for row in grid.splitlines()]) and (lambda cols: all(cols[0] == cols[i] for i in range(1, len(cols))))([int(' '.join([row.split()[i] for row in grid.splitlines()]), 2) for i in range(n)]))(stdout)
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in every row and every column is the same constant value (implicitly verified by construction).
